scope.summary: Implement the HD multi-res detail lane (spec 13.22; REQ-037/040): open multi-res sparse deltas on the MT-487 SubD cage - explicitly NO .dhdm, license guard enforced - with HD authoring open to all users via the MT-529 import pipeline, baking to vector displacement plus normal maps at export with an optional full-HD hero mesh.
acceptance_criteria: Open multi-res delta format: per-SubD-level sparse deltas stored in a documented open format on BMA- rows; the format is explicitly not .dhdm and the MT-488 license guard rejects .dhdm imports fail-closed (REQ-037).
HD authoring open to all users (REQ-040 anti-gatekeeping differentiator): HD sculpts import at a chosen SubD level through the MT-529 pipeline extended to levels.
Export bake: HD deltas bake to vector displacement plus normal maps per export profile (the Xin daz_hd_morphs precedent, native); an optional full-HD mesh lane exists for hero stills.
HD deltas compose with channels and correctives under a documented evaluation order and reconstruct from ledger replay.
scope.risk_if_missed: HD-authoring gatekeeping is Daz's most-hated vendor policy and .dhdm is license-radioactive; without an open multi-res lane with vector-displacement bake, hero closeup detail either cannot be authored or cannot leave the suite (REQ-037/040).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
